notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the senior fintech backend engineer archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in the EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Led migration of core ledger from single-region Postgres to multi-region active-active Spanner — cut cross-region write P99 from 740ms to 95ms, eliminated nightly failover drill, unblocked European payments license

Designed and shipped Go-based idempotency layer fronting the authorization path that deduplicates retries across card networks; reduced duplicate-charge tickets by 82% and cited in SOC 2 Type II report

Migrated 38 producer services off shared Kafka cluster onto tiered-storage deployment with topic-level isolation; reduced tail-latency incidents from weekly to fewer than 4 per year and cut $1.4M in annual infra spend
Built chargeback reconciliation service from scratch in Python and Postgres — auto-resolves 71% of breaks and replaced a $2.8M annual vendor product with chronic SLA misses

Tech lead on PCI DSS 4.0 readiness — refactored tokenization service to remove unencrypted PAN from logs, automated key rotation runbook from 6 hours to 12 minutes, closed Q3 2025 certification with zero findings
On-call rotation lead for 9-engineer money-movement platform — cut pages per engineer per week from 11 to 2.4 and improved mean time to mitigate from 38 minutes to 9 minutes
Mentored four engineers from senior to staff over three years and authored the technical-leadership rubric used for platform-org promotion calibration
Built real-time fraud-decisioning service scoring every authorization in under 12ms P99 with pluggable ONNX-runtime model server supporting A/B and shadow-traffic deployment
Decommissioned legacy 1,200-rule Java rules engine — migrated active rules to typed DSL, retired 60% as unused, cut decisioning P99 from 84ms to 12ms
Co-authored internal Eventing Standard for Kafka schema evolution and topic naming — adopted by 11 other teams and cited in two Kafka Summit talks
Re-architected core posting engine from synchronous request/response to event-sourced log — eliminated class of out-of-order posting bugs that had caused three regulatory near-misses
Built daily settlement-file generator producing NACHA, FedWire, and SWIFT MT103 outputs from unified ledger — processes ~$840M in daily flow
Led engineering response to first major outage at Northwind — 3-hour Postgres replication-lag partial outage; wrote postmortem and drove four follow-up workstreams

Owned queue and worker infrastructure for document-automation product in Python and RabbitMQ — scaled throughput from 800 to 26,000 documents per minute over 18 months without rewriting the data model
Built SAML SSO integration layer — shipped enterprise SSO for three largest customers and unblocked $4M in ARR

Built and open-sourced Ledgerline — a Go double-entry ledger library with idempotency keys, multi-currency support, and explicit reversal semantics; ~2.4k GitHub stars and used in production at three fintechs
Built and open-sourced postgres-bench-replay — a Go CLI capturing pg_stat_statements snapshots and replaying workloads to validate that read paths would not regress under realistic concurrency
